name: Fireworks
description: A flight through overlapping shells, each on its own staggered clock and its own depth, closing on the camera as it burns - so one is always filling the frame while the rest recede. Some are still climbing while others are only smoke. Every burst is drawn twice - discrete sparks on angular lanes, and a billow of fBm smoke lit from inside - which is what keeps it from reading as a flat ring.

smoke.description: Weight of the volumetric billow each shell leaves behind.

gravity.description: How far the shell sags as it ages.

flow.description: How far each shell travels toward the camera as it burns. 0 holds every shell at launch depth, which is the old flat framing; 1 brings them right past the lens.

rate.description: Multiplier on how often each slot re-fires.
